messages.en: I still love them, but they've moved far away.
If you want to talk, I'm here.
I bought some chocolate at the shop earlier. Want some?
Yes! Just one piece for me, please. Thanks!

senses.en_definition: Colour; the American English spelling of colour, sometimes used in Malay conversation or software interfaces instead of the standard Malay warna.

messages.en: What colour should I get? This blue one's really nice.
Does the blue one come in a size M? If it does, just get that one.
This cat is so cute! All it wants to do is sleep on my bag!
It really is cute. It's made itself comfortable there.
